parameters.query:
SELECT m.per_job_cap, m.daily_cap, m.new_seller_cap, m.paused, m.allowed_categories,
       b.available, b.spent_today,
       j.category, j.agreed_price,
       bd.price_check::text AS price_check, bd.fraud_score, bd.owner_approved_risk,
       coalesce(r.settled_jobs, 0) AS settled_jobs
FROM profiles p
LEFT JOIN mandates m   ON m.owner_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN balances b   ON b.account_id = p.near_account_id
LEFT JOIN jobs j       ON j.id = $2::uuid
LEFT JOIN bids bd      ON bd.id = j.accepted_bid_id
LEFT JOIN sellers s    ON s.id = j.seller_id
LEFT JOIN reputation r ON r.account_id = s.near_account_id
WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE chain_txs
     SET status = $2::tx_status, tx_hash = $3, error = $4, rejected_by = $5
   WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING id
), bal AS (
  -- mock mode only: move the amount from available to escrow
  UPDATE balances b
     SET available = b.available - $7::numeric,
         escrowed = b.escrowed + $7::numeric,
         spent_today = b.spent_today + $7::numeric
    FROM profiles p
   WHERE $6 = 'mock-fund' AND p.id = $8::uuid AND b.account_id = p.near_account_id
  RETURNING b.account_id
), pz AS (
  -- mock mode only: the guardian's pause
  UPDATE mandates SET paused = true, paused_by = 'guardian', paused_at = now()
   WHERE $6 = 'mock-pause' AND owner_id = $8::uuid
  RETURNING owner_id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM upd) AS id;
